messages.content: Give me a quick overview of the store performance.

Compare the top two electronics products and tell me which is the better investment.

{"category": "Electronics", "total": 2, "products": [{"id": "PROD-0003", "name": "ZenMobile Ultra 7", "price": 899.99, "avg_rating": 4.8}, {"id": "PROD-0006", "name": "AeroBook Gaming X17", "price": 1899.99, "avg_rating": 4.7}]}

{"comparison": [{"product_id": "PROD-0003", "name": "ZenMobile Ultra 7", "price": 899.99, "margin_pct": 55.2, "total_units_sold": 120, "total_revenue": 107998.8}, {"product_id": "PROD-0006", "name": "AeroBook Gaming X17", "price": 1899.99, "margin_pct": 48.3, "total_units_sold": 65, "total_revenue": 123499.35}]}

Comparing the top two: ZenMobile Ultra 7 has higher margin (55.2% vs 48.3%) and more units sold (120 vs 65), but AeroBook Gaming X17 generates more total revenue ($123,499 vs $107,999) due to its higher price point. For volume, ZenMobile is better; for revenue per SKU, AeroBook wins.

Analyze the performance of PROD-0001 and check its sales trend over the last quarter.

{"product_id": "PROD-0001", "product_name": "NovaPhone Flip Z", "total_units_sold": 87, "return_rate_pct": 3.4, "avg_rating": 3.8, "category_rank": "2/6", "sell_through_rate_pct": 42.5, "margin_pct": 52.1}

NovaPhone Flip Z (PROD-0001) has sold 87 units total with a 3.4% return rate and 4-star rating. It ranks 2nd in its category with a 42.5% sell-through rate and 52.1% margin. Q3 sales: July 28, August 32, September 27 — relatively stable with a slight peak in August.
